style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), bright warm light, rich detail, cinematic depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third and the middle fairly simple (text sits there). An ancient Mesopotamian temple city.

scenes.s1: Inside an ancient temple: many stone idols smashed into pieces on the floor, and one giant idol still standing in the middle with an axe resting on its shoulder, shafts of sunlight.
scenes.s2: A festival crowd of ordinary townspeople in colourful ancient robes leaving the temple gates, walking away toward the fields with music and banners, seen from behind.
scenes.s3: Close view of broken stone idol heads and arms scattered across a temple floor, dust in the light. No people.
scenes.s4: Angry shocked townspeople rushing back into a temple, all seen from behind, arms raised, pointing at broken idols on the floor ahead of them. Everyone is part of the crowd; no single figure stands apart or faces the camera.
scenes.s5: A giant stone idol towering over a crowd of townspeople seen from behind, an axe hanging on its shoulder, the people staring up at it in silence.
scenes.s6: An enormous fire in a stone pit whose flames are turning into soft cool golden light and gentle breeze, green leaves appearing around the edge, crowds watching from far away behind walls. No figure in the fire.
